I have just refurbished an original NES from my girlfriend's family, and I am now looking into a flash cart for the system. I have known about the PowerPak for quite a while, but the EverDrive is new to me. I am interested in both licensed games, and homebrew/hack games, so which would give me my best bang for the buck?
Who has the best NES support in 2015: PowerPak or EverDrive N8?

Congrats on the refurb! I did one myself early this year. Word of advice: do NOT clean the shell with rubbing alcohol. I did and while it made it squeaky clean, it removed the Nintendo logo from the cartridge door :/

On to your question though. I've never used either one, but I've done a good bit of research on both in the past. I know that the PowerPak is not currently (no longer?) available from its original source whereas the Everdrive N8 is. I think technically the PowerPak supports more mappers and thus more games, but only by a tiny amount and it has a lot of draw backs compared to the Everdrive. Unless you're really concerned with some of the more rare games that have expansion audio support and odd mappers, I don't see the benefit of getting the PowerPak honestly.

The Everdrive N8 is cheaper, is still available, uses the more commonly available SD cards, is easier to use for games that feature save functions, has a slightly easier to use interface, and supports almost the same number of mappers. It also has user upgradeable firmware if I'm not mistaken.

Both are awesome and getting either one won't be a wrong choice, but I'd probably pick the Everdrive N8. Just make sure you get it from the source to support its development and don't get a cheapy knock off.
